projects.name: Website Re-Architecture
projects.context: The client's site was scoring 50 on Lighthouse — slow loads, poor SEO, and a content pipeline where every text change needed a developer.
projects.what: Re-architected the entire site around Docusaurus, designed a three-layer Markdown → JSON → React content system, and extracted 45+ reusable components that non-technical teams could operate independently.
projects.result: Lighthouse jumped from 50 to 90+ across all pages. Load times dropped ~40%. Content team ships updates without touching code.

projects.name: Browser Analytics Extension
projects.context: Enterprise analytics debugging required Adobe Experience Platform and Omnibug — expensive, not tailored to the team's SPA routing patterns, and slow to iterate on.
projects.what: Built a Chrome Extension from scratch in TypeScript (MV3) with cross-tab network request capture, real-time SPA route-change detection, live event inspection, and payload comparison — all without leaving the browser.
projects.result: Replaced both Adobe Experience Platform and Omnibug entirely for the team's analytics debugging workflow. Zero onboarding cost versus the commercial tools.

projects.name: Backend Form Processing APIs
projects.context: Client campaigns were receiving spam at scale through unprotected contact forms, and unreliable SMTP delivery was causing leads to drop silently.
projects.what: Architected 8+ production REST APIs in Node.js and Express with layered defences: Google reCAPTCHA v3, IP-based rate limiting, and secure SMTP handling with delivery confirmation.
projects.result: Zero reported spam incidents post-deployment. Reliable form delivery across all client campaigns with full audit trail.
